entries.title: Psalms 25:1
segments: A Psalm of David. To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 25:2
segments: O my God, I trust in You; do not let me be ashamed, let not my enemies triumph over me.

entries.title: Psalms 25:3
segments: Yea, let none who wait on You be ashamed; let them be ashamed who sin without cause.

entries.title: Psalms 25:4
segments: Make me know Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.

entries.title: Psalms 25:5
segments: Lead me in Your truth, and teach me; for You [are] the God of my salvation; on You I wait all the day long.

entries.title: Psalms 25:6
segments: Remember, O LORD, Your tender mercies and Your loving-kindnesses; for they [are] from eternity.

entries.title: Psalms 25:7
segments: Do not remember the sins of my youth, or my rebellings; according to Your mercy remember me for Your goodness' sake, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 25:8
segments: Good and upright [is] the LORD; therefore He will teach sinners in the way.

entries.title: Psalms 25:9
segments: The meek He will guide in judgment; and the meek He will teach His way.

entries.title: Psalms 25:10
segments: All the paths of the LORD [are] mercy and truth to those who keep His covenant and His testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 25:11
segments: For Your name's sake, O LORD, pardon my iniquity; for it [is] great.

entries.title: Psalms 25:12
segments: What man [is] he who fears the LORD? He shall teach him in the way that he shall choose.

entries.title: Psalms 25:13
segments: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 25:14
segments: The secret of the LORD [is] with those who fear Him; and He will show them His covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 25:15
segments: My eyes [are] ever toward the LORD; for He shall pluck my feet out of the net.

entries.title: Psalms 25:16
segments: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I [am] wasted and afflicted.

entries.title: Psalms 25:17
segments: The troubles of my heart are enlarged; bring me out of my distresses.

entries.title: Psalms 25:18
segments: Look on my affliction and my pain, and forgive all my sins.

entries.title: Psalms 25:19
segments: Look on my enemies; for they are many; and they hate me [with] cruel hatred.

entries.title: Psalms 25:20
segments: Keep my soul, and deliver me; let me not be ashamed, for I put my trust in You.

entries.title: Psalms 25:21
segments: Let purity and uprightness keep me; for I wait on You.

entries.title: Psalms 25:22
segments: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
